title: Uniform probability of a subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $A$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The probability that a uniformly chosen vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ belongs to $A$ is $2^{-d}$, where $d$ is the dimension of the perpendicular subspace $A^\perp$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
